title: Daftar
logline: 1938-yilda to'xtagan qo'lyozma daftar avloddan avlodga o'tadi va bugungi bola uning bo'sh sahifasini yozishni boshlaydi.

style.base: Vertical 9:16 composition, shot on 35mm film, anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, natural light only. Central Asian people with warm olive skin, dark almond eyes, broad cheekbones, black hair. Uzbek domestic architecture: sun-dried clay brick, carved wooden doors, patterned cotton textiles. Photographic realism, not illustration

grades.cold: Desaturated near-monochrome, cold blue-grey shadows, heavy film grain, low contrast, faded highlights
grades.turn: Colour returning after monochrome, first warm golden light, soft and hopeful
grades.warm: Warm golden colour grade, rich saturation, soft natural highlights, gentle contrast
grades.bright: Bright clean daylight, high key, no harsh shadows

elements.name: a worn handwritten notebook with yellowed paper
elements.note: filmning qahramoni — barcha kadrlarda bir xil

elements.name: a large rusted fishing vessel on dry seabed

shots.prompt: A dark room at night. On a low wooden table an open notebook, an inkwell and a single burning candle. Frost on the window behind. Static wide shot, notebook in lower third
Extreme close-up of a weathered hand holding a wooden pen above a half-written page, frozen mid-motion. A thin blade of hard white light falls across the page
shots.narration: Uni yozgan qo'l — o'ttiz sakkizinchi yilning kuzida to'xtadi.

shots.prompt: Total darkness. A single open notebook page catches the last dim light, floating in black emptiness. High angle looking down
An endless cotton field under a white overexposed sky. In the foreground a child's small hand reaching into a cotton boll. Low camera angle from ground level
A large rusted fishing vessel tilted on cracked dry seabed, no water anywhere. Wide shot from below against a pale empty sky
A blank enamel plaque on a plastered school wall, morning sunlight striking it directly. Low angle looking up, deep blue sky above
A flag rising on a tall pole seen from directly below against the sun, fabric backlit and glowing. Extreme low angle, lens flare
An elderly wrinkled hand passing a worn notebook into a young open palm. Sunlit courtyard with grapevine canopy blurred behind. Close-up on hands
A farmer's dusty calloused hands holding a round flatbread over ripe golden wheat. Medium close shot, warm low sun behind
A young woman at a desk at night, face lit only by the cool glow of a screen off-frame, concentrating. The worn notebook lies beside her keyboard
shots.narration: Har bir qo'l unga bir satr qo'shdi.

shots.prompt: The same rusted vessel on dry seabed, now young green saxaul saplings growing around its hull. Ground level looking up past the saplings. Golden hour
shots.narration: Va eng qora sahifa — yashil bo'la boshladi.

shots.prompt: Looking straight down at a blank notebook page as a child's hand begins to write with a pencil. The pencil tip has just touched the paper
shots.narration: Yangi hayot va kelajakni — biz yozamiz.
